name: DreamxBotz Auto Filter Bot
description: Telegram auto-filter bot for indexing channel files and searching them quickly.

CHANNELS.description: Channel or group usernames/IDs for indexing. Separate multiple values by spaces.

ADMINS.description: Admin Telegram user IDs or usernames. Separate multiple values by spaces.

OWNER_ID.description: Owner Telegram user ID(s). Owner-only commands work only for these. If empty, the first ADMINS id is the owner.

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Telegram log channel ID, usually starts with -100.

AUTH_USERS.description: Optional allowed user IDs/usernames for inline search. Separate multiple values by spaces.

AUTH_CHANNELS.description: Optional force subscription channel IDs. Bot must be admin in these channels.

DATABASE_URI2.description: Optional second MongoDB URI. Required only when MULTIPLE_DB is enabled.

COLLECTION_NAME.description: MongoDB collection name. Use a unique collection name if sharing one database across multiple bots.

POST_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional 2nd (helper) bot token. The Click-here links of every post card open this bot. Make it admin in BIN_CHANNEL and the force-sub channels. Empty = off.

POSTCARD_CHANNEL.description: PostCardDaily: private channel ID (-100...) where every post card is sent. Bot must be admin. Empty = cards go to MOVIE_UPDATE_CHANNEL.

NAME_BRAND_EMOJI.description: Emoji put in front of every file name in captions and post headings. Empty = off.

NAME_BRAND_TAG.description: Brand tag put before the extension of every file name. Empty = off. Not added twice when your caption already shows it.
